dimensionality.question: How much depth should the site have?

values.flat: Typographic and still. No depth cues.
values.depth: Layered — parallax, shadow, scroll motion. No 3D.

dimensionality.note: 3d is not offered by this pack (no WebGL scene library).

values.luxe: Restrained, expensive, high-contrast. Space as a luxury good.
values.technical: Precise, instrumented, data-forward. Mono, grids, readouts.
values.organic: Soft, flowing, natural. Curves and gradients.
values.brutal: Raw, loud, high-friction. Heavy type, hard edges.

values.still: Essentially static. Motion only on interaction.
values.subtle: Gentle reveals and easing. Motion you notice only if you look.
values.lively: Continuous ambient motion. The page is never quite at rest.
values.intense: Motion is the point. Big, fast, hard to ignore.

values.sparse: One idea per screen. Lots of air.

tokens.od-surface-raised: The surface above a surface. Modals, popovers.
tokens.od-accent: The one hue that carries the brand.
tokens.od-accent-ink: Text that sits ON the accent. Must pass contrast.
tokens.od-tracking-display: Letter-spacing for display type. Often negative.
tokens.od-radius: Base corner radius. 0 reads brutal; large reads playful.

axesNote: Axes are ranking HINTS, not a questionnaire and not a gate.
